questions.q: Which of these is the longest river in the world?
questions.x: The Nile is traditionally considered the longest river, measuring approximately 6,650 km.

questions.q: The 'Ring of Fire' is primarily associated with which geological feature?
questions.x: The Ring of Fire is a major area in the basin of the Pacific Ocean where many earthquakes and volcanic eruptions occur.

questions.q: Which continent is the Sahara Desert located in?
questions.x: The Sahara Desert is the largest hot desert in the world and is located in Africa.

questions.q: The 'Great Barrier Reef' is located off the coast of which country?
questions.x: The Great Barrier Reef is the world's largest coral reef system, located in Australia.

questions.q: Which of these is the largest ocean in the world?
questions.x: The Pacific Ocean is the largest and deepest ocean, covering more than 30% of Earth's surface.

questions.q: The 'Andes' mountain range runs through which continent?
questions.x: The Andes is the longest continental mountain range in the world, stretching along the western side of South America.

questions.q: Which country is home to the world's largest rainforest, the Amazon Rainforest?
questions.x: The Amazon Rainforest spans several countries, but Brazil contains the largest portion of it.

questions.q: The 'Dead Sea' is located between which two countries?
questions.x: The Dead Sea is a salt lake bordered by Israel and Jordan, known for its high salinity.

questions.q: Who was the first Indian to become the President of the Indian National Congress?
questions.x: Womesh Chandra Bonnerjee, a barrister from Calcutta, was elected the first Indian President of the Indian National Congress in 1885.

questions.q: Which revolutionary organization was founded by Bhagat Singh, Sukhdev, and Shivaram Rajguru?
questions.x: The HSRA was formed in 1928 to fight British colonial rule through armed revolution, with Bhagat Singh as a key leader.

questions.q: The 'Quit India Movement' was launched in which year?
questions.x: The 'Quit India Movement' (August 1942) was a mass protest launched by Gandhi to demand an end to British rule.

questions.q: Which of these leaders was associated with the 'Swadeshi Movement'?
questions.x: All three leaders were prominent figures in the Swadeshi Movement (1905), which promoted boycott of British goods.

questions.q: The 'Poona Pact' was signed between Mahatma Gandhi and which leader?
questions.x: The Poona Pact (1932) resolved the deadlock over separate electorates for depressed classes, negotiated by Gandhi and Ambedkar.

questions.q: Which Indian freedom fighter was known as the 'Lion of Punjab'?
questions.x: Lala Lajpat Rai earned the title due to his fiery speeches and resistance against British policies in Punjab.

questions.q: The 'Dandi March' was part of which movement?
questions.x: Gandhi’s Dandi March (1930) was a key event in the Civil Disobedience Movement, protesting the salt tax.

questions.q: Which British official was assassinated by Udham Singh in 1940?
questions.x: Udham Singh avenged the Jallianwala Bagh massacre by assassinating Michael O'Dwyer, the Governor of Punjab.
